A dual water reservoir and a dual-scraper structure let the E28 clean its mop in real time. The mop stays fresh from the first room to the last.
The industry's first detachable portable deep cleaner is built into the Omni Station. Use it on carpets, stairs and other fabric surfaces.
The E28 delivers professional-grade deep cleaning on carpets and hard floors alike, lifting even deeply embedded dust and hair.
DuoSpiral brushes stop hair from wrapping around the roller and reduce how often the robot needs maintenance.
The CornerRover arm ensures 100% edge coverage, so walls and corners are cleaned as thoroughly as open floor.
The station empties the dustbin, washes and hot-air dries the mop, dispenses detergent automatically, collects wastewater and refills clean water. Your part is simply to press start.
Update the robot to the latest firmware through the app to keep cleaning performance at its best and unlock new functions.
